adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB write `await prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` occurs before `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. There is no transaction/compensating logic around these steps, and `updateCalendarAttendees` is not wrapped in a try/catch, so if the external calendar update throws, the handler will fail after the attendees are already committed. This can leave the database showing new attendees while the external calendar event remains unchanged (and potentially the client sees an error despite the DB change).
